semantics.identity_rule: Web instance, listener, route, page, asset and runtime identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: start/stop/rebind/reload/recover operations invoke separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing web runtime state grants no lifecycle authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Route/page/asset edges correspond only to explicit refs.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.
